book.name: Luk
book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Yesus ya Sakias takis yungwa yagle
Ana Yesus Jeriko kamun suna pindre igle konbauna du yene endongwa.
Yagl suwarata igle moglkwa ye kangiye Sakias, ye takis ingwa yomba mina yagl kande moglkwa. Ye taragl merkinde paitongwa.
Ye eremogl Yesus ira moglmedi kanagledi yombuglo orkwa, ba ye yagl sungunagle moglkwa pre kanambuka mere manga, sraglpre, yomba merkinde kaima meglkwa.
Yeglpre ye mukundi ende okuna pindre, Yesus konbo igle unan kanagledi pre, endi kogla ta mongo ende egli ongwa.
Ana Yesus ende magl angai dumo igle undre, kan mitna ende ana yegl di Sakias tongwa, “Ene oglandi ende atne wo, na erme ene yungun mina moraglka.”
Sakias tambre kaima ende atne undre, ana gun argan bogl diwakai yei Yesus auro yend yungumugl ongwa.
Yomba prapra i kandre, ana mambuno bogl ninubenu di, nonga sindre dingwa, “Ana yagl i pi tandaglme orkwa yagl ikra yungumo mina moglkwa.”

Ba Sakias andigltre, ana di Yaglkande tongwa, “Kano! Yaglkande, erme enge igle na taragl ake-neinga sunawom yumbusi ikine kiuglgiunde yomba tenaglka, ana yomba taratno na kakimbi dite kunogl inga panan ana kuiya 4 pandigl tembe ende te ikine endinaglka.”
Yesus eremogl Sakias ditongwa, “Erme yomba yungugl igle meglkwa God ere-yungwa, sraglpre yagl i ama Abraham wam moglkwa.
Ana Yomba Wam yomba taya eingwa i dokindre ana ere-ina pre ungwa.”
Kongun yomba 10 moni ingwa pre di boglkwa
Yomba ka i pir meglkwa enge, Yesus ama ka aine di simbogl suwarata di ye tongwa. Sraglpre, ye Jerusalem mangigl ongo ana yomba eremogl God kingdomo oglandi plau dinambedi pirkwa.
Ye dungwa, “Yagl kande ta igle moglkwa ye ende kamun kande eglke ta pindre, ana king mogltre, ana okuwo ende ikine yungumugl unambuka.
Yeglpre ye kongunmo yomba 10 aglendi indre ana yomba suwarandi moni mongo
tendre, ana ditongwa, ‘Moni i ene kongunmo ere kuiya ere meglmbi ana na ende ikine unaglka.’
“Ba yene kamunmo mina yomba kumbro tendre, ana ka kep yomba tau ye ka yegl yomba ditenaglmedi pre ye omara okuwo diendingwa, ‘No yagl i kingno ta morambedi pirkunga.’
“Ba king kangiye yeingo, ana ye ende ikine kamunmo mina ungwa. Ana ye oglandi yomba diende kongun yomba moni tongwa ikra kongun ere moni kuiya imere kanagledi pre ditembi wiyondo dungwa.
“Yagl ta okuna kana moni kur yungwa ikra undre yegl dungwa, ‘Yagl kande, ene moni mongo natnga i na kongun ertre ana moni mongo 10 ta ama isuna endinga.’
“Yagl kande di ikine endungwa, ‘Na konguna yomba wakai, ene kongun wakai kaima etnga, ene diendimbo dumo kande 10 sugl moratnga, sraglpre, ene kongun kembra i mina sugl wakai motnga.’
“Mokomugl yagl ta moni kur yungwa ikra undre ana dungwa, ‘Yaglkande, ene moni natngra i na kongun ertre ana moni mongo 5 ama isuna endinga.’
“Ana yaglmo kande ditongwa, ‘Ene dumo kande 5 sugl moratnga.’
“Ana kongun yomba ta moni kur yungwa ikra undre dungwa, ‘Yaglkande, ene moninen yongwa yawe, na gagl alap kembra mina were teke yeinga.
Na ene kundutn goglka, sraglpre, ene yombuglo etnga yaglmo ene taragl enene ta yeikitnara indre te mokna mongo enene sunduglkitnara utnga.’
“Yombamo kande di ye tongwa, ‘Ene kongun yomba kinde, enene ka dinara i mina na ene ka tenaglka. Ene pitnga na yagl yombuglo erika, na taragl ta yeikrimara indre te na taragl yaglkrimara urtre erika.
Yegl panan, sraglpre ene na monina ipi benk endekitne? Ana okuwo na ikine undre moni kuiya panan akiye i-ikine endinaglka.’
“Ana ye eremogl yomba mangigl andigl meglkwa i ditongwa, ‘Moni mongo ye mina ikorugl ende, ana kongun yomba moni mongo 10 ake moglkwa yagle i teiyo.’
“Ye diteingwa, ‘Yaglkande, ye moni mongo 10 kande ake moglkwa.’
“Ye di ikine endungwa, ‘Na ene diteinga, yomba prapra taragl paitenambuka ye taragl mere tenaglka ba yomba taragl ta paitekrambuka ye mina taragl kuri ta paitongwa i, ikorugl endinaglka.
Ba na kundana ikine i, ye na kingno moglkrambedi pirkwa yomba auro imangigl ya undre, ana na gumanamugl ya sigolo.’”
Yesus king mereyegl ende Jerusalem suna ongwa
Yesus ka di kondo okuwo ye ende Jerusalem ena pre okuna kana ende yenda ongwa.
Ye ende Betfasi ya Betani kamun muglo kangiye Olip we dimara igle mangigl pindre ana ye disaipelmo suwo di okuna ende yegl ditongwa,
“Ene ende yungu epigl nongagle yomara iro piro, ana ende suna pindre, kanambrika dongi kowo ta igle kane kogl pandiglkwa, buglamo dongi i yomba ta ausi i-wankrikwa. Ene kane poko ende i ya wiro.
Ana yomba ta ene krapoglte, ‘Ene sraglpre dongi kane pokimbre?’ dinan. Ye diteiro, ‘Dongi i Yaglkande kongunmo ta erambuka pangwa.’”
Yagl suwo diendungwa ikra pindre ana kanbriko taragl prapra ditomere mere pangwa.
Ye dongi kowo kane poko miurko ana kiglkwa yomba krapogl teingwa, “Ene sraglpre dongi kane poko endimbre?”
Ye di ikine endimbrika, “I Yaglkande kongunmo ta erambuka pangwa.”
Ye dongi iyu Yesus moglmara undre, ana ye gatno suna olto gugl dongi moko mina yendre, ana ye akeple dingo Yesus tembe igle amedungwa.
Ana ye dongi mina ausi mogl konbauna endongo, yomba gatno suna olto gugl konbauna ake waidi yeingwa.

Ye ende wu Olip Kamun Muglo konbauna ende atne omara mangigl ungo, ana disaipelmo merkinde kaima wingwa. I ye gun pond kaima yeingwa. Sraglpre, ye prapra kimagl mere okuna orko kanigwa pre, mangre sipu dindre, ana God dembiyesi mitna imbo kaima endingwa.
Ana Parisi wagle tau yomba merkinde meglmara suna mogltre ana Yesus diteingwa, “Beke Notnga, ene disaipelma wagle ka-temin ye kiendi molondo.”
Yesus di ikine ende ana ditongwa, “Na ene diteinga, ye kiendi meglmbi, ana kombuglo yene kaglkane inaglkwa.”
Yesus Jerusalem pre kai orkwa
Ana ye ende Jerusalem mangigl wu siti kandre, kaimo pond ere,
ana ye dungwa, “Jerusalem, ande enge erme i keunde nomano bipokndi yenambuka i ene pirpogl singa, ba taragl i erme ene ongumutn mina teke pangwa.
Enge tau yenan ene kundan ikine totn mina mogl winambodi mundu siget-dindre ana ene sina pre isuna ende kondinaglkwa.

Ye eremogl ene ya yomba totn suna meglkwa i ama akiye siderwagl baruwagl ere kondinaglkwa. Ana kombuglo suwarata kombuglo ta bolamugl yeikrambuka. Sraglpre, God ene ere-inambuka engemo ungo ene kanpogl sikitnga.”
God holi yungumo mina yomba taragl topo eremeglko Yesus simenda endungwa
Ana Yesus ende God holi yungumo mina togl suna pindre, yomba taragl topo eremeglko simenda endungwa.

Yesus eremogl yomba ditongwa, “Kamambuno mina muno beglko pangwa i God yegl dungwa, ‘Na yunguna i kamange yungu we dinaglkwa.’ Ba ene eriko, God holi yungumo yomba kunogl gogl ne wu kombuglo mur teke paimere yeglmere ongwa.”
Ande engenge Yesus eremogl God holi yungumo mina kamambuno beke yomba tongwa. Ba pris kande wagle ya lo beke teingwa yomba ya te yomba mina ende okuna eingwa ye Yesus sigoramnedi pirkwa.
Ba ye konbo ta doko kan indre ere sinaglkwa mere manga, sraglpre, yomba prapra ye ka dumara i aimande yombugl i suna ende pir meglkwa.

footnotes.text: Moni i, ba suwota kongun ere topo imere yegl mere yongwa.
